source: Dinner picks from OpenTable's Reno romantic-restaurant list (reviews through Sep 2026); attractions from official museum and Washoe County pages. Coordinates: Wikipedia for landmarks, Weekend Scout venue file for casino restaurants (Nominatim unreachable this run).

spots.name: Nevada Museum of Art
spots.blurb: Nevada's art museum, open Tuesday to Sunday (Thursdays until 8 p.m.); kids 5 and under free.
spots.blurbEs: El museo de arte de Nevada, abierto de martes a domingo (jueves hasta las 8 p.m.); niños de 5 años o menos gratis.

spots.name: National Automobile Museum
spots.blurb: The Harrah collection of classic and movie cars, a short walk from the river.
spots.blurbEs: La colección Harrah de autos clásicos y de película, a pocos pasos del río.

spots.name: Rancho San Rafael Regional Park
spots.blurb: Big county park with the Wilbur D. May Arboretum, the May Museum and an off-leash dog area.
spots.blurbEs: Gran parque del condado con el Wilbur D. May Arboretum, el May Museum y una zona para perros sin correa.

spots.name: Idlewild Park
spots.blurb: Riverside park along the Truckee with lawns, a pond and the historic California Building.
spots.blurbEs: Parque junto al río Truckee con prados, un estanque y el histórico California Building.

spots.name: Truckee River Walk
spots.blurb: Downtown riverside path past shops, bars and Wingfield Park.
spots.blurbEs: Paseo del centro junto al río, con tiendas, bares y Wingfield Park.
